home_title: Free AI, running on your computer
home_lead: Your AI tools can use free models from many providers through one local address. FreeAITokens picks a model for each request and moves on when one runs out.
play_empty: Ask anything. Each answer shows which provider and model gave it, and how long it took.
prompt_placeholder: Write a message… (⌘/Ctrl + Enter to send)
tools_lead: Open a coding tool in a new terminal window, already set up to use free models. Your tool's own settings stay as they are.
other_apps_text: Zed, JetBrains, VS Code, Cline, Continue and any app that takes an OpenAI-compatible address: paste the address and key from Home, and use the model free.
tool_opening: Opening {name} in a new terminal window.
prov_lead: Each provider you add gives you more free use. Keys stay in your computer's keychain.
usage_lead: Every call to a provider counts, including ones FreeAITokens retried elsewhere. Kept on this computer for 90 days.
no_requests: No requests in this range yet.
set_login_text: Open FreeAITokens in the background when you log in.
set_chats_text: Saved chats stay on this computer only.
confirm_delete: Delete all saved chats? This cannot be undone.
set_key_text: The local token your apps use.
err_send: That message could not be sent.
err_model: That model is not available. Pick another one.
err_account: the Account ID is missing or not valid
menu_reused: Using the endpoint already running on port {port}
add_lead: Use your own account, one per provider. Keys are tested, then stored in your system keychain.
add_connect_text: Sign in to OpenRouter in your browser and approve the connection. No key to copy.
add_all_done: Every provider already has a key.
image_placeholder: Describe the picture you want… (⌘/Ctrl + Enter to create)
image_gone: This image's file is no longer on this computer.
svg_preview: Preview of the SVG code below
no_image_providers: To create images, add Cloudflare or OpenRouter. Both are free.
err_image: No picture came back. Try again or pick another model.
no_speech_providers: To make speech, add OpenRouter, Groq or Cloudflare. All are free.
no_transcription_providers: To transcribe audio, add Groq or Cloudflare. Both are free.
err_audio: That file is not audio this app can read. Use MP3, M4A, WAV, WebM, OGG or FLAC.
err_speech: No speech came back. Try again.
audio_too_big: That file is over 25 MB. Pick a shorter one.
